etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from French unique. Piecewise doublet of any.

definitions.definition: (not comparable) Being the only one of its kind; unequaled, unparalleled or unmatched.

quote.citation: 1920, Robert W. Lawson, Relativity: The Special and General Theory, translation of original by Albert Einstein:
quote.text: Perhaps the reader will wonder why we have placed our " beings " on a sphere rather than on another closed surface. But this choice has its justification in the fact that, of all closed surfaces, the sphere is unique in possessing the property that all points on it are equivalent.
